narr: With yet another strong occluded low located across the north-central Conus, and a cold front stretching southward through the Mississippi Valley, Kentucky found itself in a warm and unstable airmass. Despite the overnight hours and cooling temps, storms persisted in parts of the Jackson, KY county warning area. One of these storms moved through Laurel County, resulting in a downed tree and isolated flash flooding after midnight.
ev: A car was reportedly swept away by flood waters at the 600 block of Rita Lane in Lily. The occupant had to be rescued from their vehicle. Time of event is based on time of report at 2:10 AM EDT.
